description: This file contains unit tests for GatewayChannel functionality within the OpenClaw project, focusing on WebSocket connection handling, token reconfiguration, request handling, and event stream subscriptions.

classes.name: GatewayConnectionTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests validating WebSocket connection management, token reconfiguration, request reuse, and event subscription behavior for Gateway connections.

classes.name: ConfigSource
classes.description: A helper class for managing the token configuration with thread-safe access.

methods.name: makeConnection
methods.description: Creates a GatewayConnection instance with a specified WebSocket session and optional token.

methods.name: makeSession
methods.description: Produces a mock WebSocket session with customizable delay for testing connection behaviors.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Updates the token in ConfigSource in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: snapshotToken
methods.description: Returns the current token value in a thread-safe manner.
